The Board vide its Meeting dated March 25, 2025 had accepted the resignation of Prof. (Dr.) Surabhi Banerjee from the position of Chairperson of the Company effective March 31, 2025 (COB) due to personal reasons. However, she will continue to act as an Independent Director of the Company for the remaining period of her tenure.
2. 3. Subject to approval of the Members of the Company, the Board vide its Meeting dated March 25, 2025 had re-designated and appointed Mr. Rittick Roy Burman as Managing Director of the Company for a fresh term of 3 (Three) consecutive years effective April 01, 2025.
4. Subject to approval of the Members of the Company, the Board vide its Meeting dated March 25, 2025 had re-designated Mrs. Upama Mukherjee from Non-Executive Non-Independent Director to Independent Director of the Company effective April 01, 2025.
